description: exp019 - phase 2: champion lineage reduced to SINGLE STREAM + HyperplaneCodeLUT unembedder. From exp018 (LayerNorm E=384 champion) with two changes: (1) remove the dual stream - no emb_resid_lut, no per-layer residual_lut, no D-stream; single residual stream x dim E=384; block = LayerNorm(x)->qk/v LUT->RoPE softmax attn->out_proj LUT->x+=out_proj; after layers ln_final(x) KEPT -> unembedder. (2) replace Linear(384->32768) unembedder with HyperplaneCodeLUT (nap=15 -> V=2^15=32768, T=16 tables, input_dim E=384): per-code soft-sign scores gated by w_cell, voted over 16 tables, no stored per-cell rows. Everything else identical to exp010/exp018: 6 layers, 6 heads d_qk=d_v=64, ctx512, vocab32768, RoPE1e4, untied tok_emb, LUT qk nap4/tph256, v nap6/tph256, out_proj nap7/tph512 (HyperplaneMHL, anchor_pairs, hard, bf16 tables/fp32 hyperplanes), LayerNorm everywhere, seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tokens/step, LR over 16000 (warmup1600 cosine 0.1x floor), Lion lut_lr 2e-4 (LUT tables) / AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (hyperplanes+code-LUT hyperplane_weight/bias no-wd by name; w_cell + unembed-slot wd0.1; tok_emb/norms wd0), grad clip 1.0. Much cheaper/smaller than the exp010 dual-stream champion (baseline best_val_bpb 1.1940 @ 324.7M). Unembedder ~= 46,560 (T*nap*(E+1)) + 524,288 (T*V) hmm E=384 so hyperplanes 16*15*385=92,400 + w_cell 16*32768=524,288 ~ 616,688 params.
